title: LDA Intuition: Maximizing Class Separation in Machine Learning Algorithms

cues.en: -: Hi everyone, and welcome to the intuition lecture for linear discriminate analysis, or LDA.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎來到線性判別分析，也就是 LDA 的直覺教學。

cues.en: Now, for those of you who are coming from the previous section on principle component analysis, or PCA, this may seem a bit similar but there is a difference between the two,
cues.zh: 如果剛學完上一節主成分分析 PCA，可能覺得很相似，但兩者有差別，

cues.en: and we're gonna get started by taking a look at overall what LDA entails.
cues.zh: 先整體看看 LDA 包含什麼。

cues.en: It's a pretty brief and straightforward intuition lecture, but we'll get to the main takeaways between PCA and LDA.
cues.zh: 這堂直覺課簡短直接，但會掌握 PCA 與 LDA 的主要差異。

cues.en: LDA is commonly used as a dimensionality reduction technique, and we've heard that before with PCA.
cues.zh: LDA 常作為降維技術，這點先前 PCA 也提過。

cues.en: It's used in the pre-processing step for pattern classification and machine learning algorithms, and its goal is to project a data set
cues.zh: 它用在樣式分類與機器學習演算法的前處理，目標是將資料集投影

cues.en: onto a lower dimensional space.
cues.zh: 到較低維的空間。

cues.en: Sounds similar to PCA, but LDA differs, because in addition to finding the component axes with LDA we are interested in the axes
cues.zh: 聽起來像 PCA，但 LDA 不同，因為除了找出成分軸，還關心能讓多個類別

cues.en: that maximize the separation between multiple classes.
cues.zh: 分隔程度最大的軸。

cues.en: And that is the main takeaway, or the main point, is where PCA we are with that distinction and working with the principal component analysis with the axes, the principal components within the data.
cues.zh: 這就是重點。PCA 關心的是資料中的主成分軸，

cues.en: But where as we're looking in LDA, we are looking for the separation of those classes within the data.
cues.zh: 而 LDA 尋找的是資料中類別的區隔。

cues.en: And to break it down further, the goal of LDA is to project a feature space onto a small subspace, while maintaining the class discriminatory information.
cues.zh: 進一步說，LDA 要將特徵空間投影到較小的子空間，同時保留類別判別資訊。

cues.en: And we have both PCA and LDA as linear transformation techniques used for dimensionality reduction.
cues.zh: PCA 與 LDA 都是用於降維的線性轉換技術。

cues.en: PCA is a unsupervised algorithm, but LDA is supervised because of the relation to the dependent variable.
cues.zh: PCA 是非監督式演算法，LDA 則因為與依變數有關，是監督式的。

cues.en: And we can see here from this visualization the main operations and main differences between PCA and LDA.
cues.zh: 這張視覺化顯示兩者的主要操作與差異。

cues.en: PCA, again, we're looking in that subspace and the dimensionality reduction technique of the data to examine how the principal component axis are in relation,
cues.zh: PCA 是在資料的子空間中，檢視主成分軸的關係，

cues.en: whereas in LDA we're looking for that class separation and I, think this visualization kind of makes it the most clear between the two.
cues.zh: LDA 則尋找類別區隔。我認為這張圖最清楚地呈現兩者差異。

cues.en: If you want some additional information, you can always take a look at the following link, but here we have the PCA and LDA, and the main operations related to each.
cues.zh: 想知道更多，可以看以下連結；這裡列出 PCA、LDA 與各自的主要操作。

cues.en: Again, LDA supervised because of the relation to the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 再次提醒，LDA 因為與依變數相關，是監督式的。

cues.en: And I think when you start working through this in the upcoming lecture and the hands on part, it's gonna make more sense.
cues.zh: 接下來開始實作時，應該會更理解。

cues.en: But that's the main takeaway to focus on LDA.
cues.zh: 這是理解 LDA 最主要的重點。

cues.en: And you can accomplish this by five main steps.
cues.zh: 可以透過五個主要步驟來完成。

cues.en: Similar again to PCA.
cues.zh: 同樣與 PCA 相似。

cues.en: The five main steps for LDA include the following.
cues.zh: LDA 的五個主要步驟如下。

cues.en: The computation of the d-dimensional mean vectors, the computation of the scatter matrices.
cues.zh: 計算 d 維平均向量、計算散布矩陣。

cues.en: You have to also compute the eigenvectors, sort the eigenvectors by decreasing eigenvalues, and use the D times K eigenvector matrix
cues.zh: 還要計算特徵向量，按特徵值遞減順序排列，再用 D × K 的特徵向量矩陣，

cues.en: to transform the samples onto the new subspace.
cues.zh: 將樣本轉換到新的子空間。

cues.en: Overall, very similar to PCA two different types of dimensionality reduction techniques, one being unsupervised and one being supervised.
cues.zh: 整體上和 PCA 很相似，都是降維技術，一個非監督式、一個監督式。

cues.en: But the main distinction with LDA to take away is that we're looking for that class separation within the data.
cues.zh: 但 LDA 要掌握的主要差別，是尋找資料內類別的區隔。

cues.en: Overall, if you're coming from PCA, this should seem familiar for the majority of operations.
cues.zh: 如果剛學過 PCA，大部分操作應該都很熟悉。

cues.en: If you're new to this, I advise you to go take a look at PCA as well.
cues.zh: 如果是第一次接觸，建議也去看看 PCA。

cues.en: But when you are starting to work through the next upcoming part it should make more sense.
cues.zh: 開始做下一部分時，應該就會更明白。

cues.en: But just keep in mind that the main takeaway for LDA is that class separation, and it is a supervised learning technique.
cues.zh: 只要記得 LDA 的重點是類別區隔，而且是監督式學習技術。

cues.en: If you have any questions, as always please feel free to share them, and enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 和往常一樣，有問題請隨時提出，享受機器學習的樂趣吧。
